name: Traveler’s Ring
body:
Aura faint transmutation, faint divination, faint abjuration; CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 1,600 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is a signet ring with a compass engraved in its face.

It grants the wearer longstrider 2/day, know direction 2/day, and endure elements 1/day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells longstrider, know direction, endure elements; Cost 800 gp

Identification DC 16
